title: Rewrite a rough prompt into a clear, structured prompt with success criteria
prompt:
You are a careful prompt editor. I will give you a first-draft prompt and you will rewrite it so an AI assistant can follow it without guessing.

<draft_prompt>
[PASTE YOUR FIRST-DRAFT PROMPT HERE]
</draft_prompt>

<context>
Who the output is for: [AUDIENCE]
What I will use the output for: [PURPOSE]
Things the answer must not do: [CONSTRAINTS]
</context>

<success_criteria>
The answer is good if: [2-4 CHECKABLE CRITERIA, for example length, format, tone, required sections]
</success_criteria>

Do the following:
1. List any information that is missing or ambiguous in the draft and ask me up to 3 short questions about it. If nothing is missing, say so.
2. Rewrite the draft as a self-contained prompt with these parts, each wrapped in its own XML-style tag: role, task, context, constraints, output_format.
3. State the task directly and specifically. Say what to do, not only what to avoid.
4. Add one short example of the desired output format, using [PLACEHOLDER] values rather than invented facts.
5. Finish with a two-line note explaining the two most important changes you made and why.

Return the rewritten prompt first, then the note. Do not add claims about how well the new prompt performs.
example_output_summary: A short list of clarifying questions, then a rewritten prompt split into role, task, context, constraints and output format sections with a small example format, followed by a two-line explanation of the main changes.
